import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
scratch = Path(__file__).parent
evidence = root/'docs/features/active/2026-10-17-legacy-discovery-and-parity-980/evidence/regression-testing'
paths = ['packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_dotnet.py', 'tests/discovery_runtime/analyzer/test_dependency_dotnet.py']
shared = ['packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_inputs.py', 'packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_values.py']
label, stage = sys.argv[1:3]
coverage_path = scratch/(label+'-coverage.json')
commands = {
    'format':['poetry','run','black',*paths],
    'lint':['poetry','run','ruff','check',*paths],
    'types':['poetry','run','pyright',*paths],
    'unit':['poetry','run','pytest',paths[1],'-o','addopts=','-v','--cov=drm_copilot_discovery.analyzer.dependency_dotnet','--cov-branch','--cov-report=term-missing','--cov-report=json:'+str(coverage_path)],
}
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def bindings(names):
    return {p:{'sha256':sha((root/p).read_bytes()),'physical_lines':len((root/p).read_bytes().splitlines())} for p in names}
def portable(value):
    return value.replace(str(scratch),'SCRATCH').replace(scratch.as_posix(),'SCRATCH').replace(str(root),'WORKSPACE').replace(root.as_posix(),'WORKSPACE')
before, shared_before = bindings(paths), bindings(shared)
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
timer = time.monotonic()
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['COVERAGE_FILE']=str(scratch/(label+'.coverage'))
process = subprocess.run(commands[stage],capture_output=True,env=environment)
finished = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
stamp = finished.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M')
streams={}
for name,data in [('stdout',process.stdout),('stderr',process.stderr)]:
    path=scratch/(label+'-'+stage+'.'+finished.strftime('%H%M%S%f')+'.'+name+'.bin')
    path.write_bytes(data)
    streams[name]={'path':'SCRATCH/'+path.name,'raw_sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data),'presentation':portable(data.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'))}
receipt={'stage':stage,'command':portable(subprocess.list2cmdline(commands[stage])),'started':started.isoformat(),'finished':finished.isoformat(),'duration_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-timer,3),'exit_code':process.returncode,'source_before':before,'source_after':bindings(paths),'shared_before':shared_before,'shared_after':bindings(shared),'streams':streams,'harness':{'path':'SCRATCH/'+Path(__file__).name,'sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())},'review':'p4t7-executor-format-review.2026-10-19T10-23.json FR2','scope':'Only .NET parser/test repair; predecessor proof reused'}
base=evidence/(label+'-'+stage+'.'+stamp)
target=Path(str(base)+'.json')
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
# Escape control bytes in the readable Markdown; the raw binary streams remain exact.
rendered=json.dumps({name:value['presentation'] for name,value in streams.items()},indent=2)
Path(str(base)+'.md').write_text('# P4-T7 .NET FR2 scoped repair gate\n\nTimestamp: '+stamp+'\nCommand: '+receipt['command']+'\nEXIT_CODE: '+str(process.returncode)+'\n\nWORKSPACE/SCRATCH are path tokens. Output control characters are JSON-escaped below; original streams are separately hash-bound. New evidence uses explicit LF.\n\n```json\n'+rendered+'\n```\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'exit_code':process.returncode,'bindings':receipt['source_after']}))
print((streams['stdout']['presentation']+streams['stderr']['presentation'])[-6000:])
sys.exit(process.returncode)

import ast
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

root=Path.cwd()
scratch=Path(__file__).parent
feature=root/'docs/features/active/2026-10-17-legacy-discovery-and-parity-980'
folder=feature/'evidence/regression-testing'
label=sys.argv[1]
stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M')
source='packages/discovery-runtime/src/drm_copilot_discovery/analyzer/dependency_dotnet.py'
test='tests/discovery_runtime/analyzer/test_dependency_dotnet.py'
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def bind(path):
    return {'path':path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(path.read_bytes()),'bytes':path.stat().st_size}
def save(name,value):
    target=folder/(name+'.'+stamp+'.json')
    assert not target.exists()
    target.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    return target
receipts=sorted(folder.glob(label+'-*.json'))
assert len(receipts)==4
for path in receipts:
    value=json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert value['exit_code']==0 and value['source_before']==value['source_after']
    assert value['shared_before']==value['shared_after']
    for name in (source,test):
        assert value['source_after'][name]['sha256']==sha((root/name).read_bytes())
    for stream in value['streams'].values():
        assert sha((scratch/stream['path'].removeprefix('SCRATCH/')).read_bytes())==stream['raw_sha256']
unit_path=next(p for p in receipts if '-unit.' in p.name)
unit=json.loads(unit_path.read_text())
for name,binding in unit['shared_after'].items():
    assert binding['sha256']==sha((root/name).read_bytes())
old_nodes=json.loads((folder/'p4t7-dotnet-nodes.2026-10-19T10-09.json').read_text())['nodes']
nodes=re.findall(r'^(tests/.*) PASSED ',unit['streams']['stdout']['presentation'],re.MULTILINE)
assert set(old_nodes)<=set(nodes) and len(nodes)==73
coverage_source=scratch/(label+'-coverage.json')
coverage=save('p4t7-dotnet-repair-coverage',json.loads(coverage_source.read_bytes()))
metrics=next(iter(json.loads(coverage.read_bytes())['files'].values()))
assert not metrics['missing_lines'] and not metrics['missing_branches']
executed=set(metrics['executed_lines'])
ranges=[]
for node in ast.walk(ast.parse((root/source).read_text())):
    if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef):
        covered=sorted(executed.intersection(range(node.lineno,node.end_lineno+1)))
        assert covered
        ranges.append({'name':node.name,'start':node.lineno,'end':node.end_lineno,'covered_lines':covered,'missing_lines':[],'percent':100})
originals=[folder/'p4t7-dotnet-freeze.2026-10-19T10-09.json',folder/'p4t7-dotnet-staging-manifest.2026-10-19T10-09.json',folder/'p4t7-dotnet-publication-index.2026-10-19T10-15.json',feature/'evidence/qa-gates/p4t7-executor-format-review.2026-10-19T10-23.json',feature/'evidence/qa-gates/p4t7-executor-format-probe.2026-10-19T10-18.json',feature/'evidence/qa-gates/p4t7-executor-format-probe-harness.2026-10-19T10-18.txt']
save('p4t7-dotnet-repair-harnesses',{'executed':[{'path':'SCRATCH/'+p.name,'sha256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'source':p.read_text()} for p in [scratch/'p4t7-dotnet-repair-gates.py',Path(__file__)]]})
freeze=save('p4t7-dotnet-repair-freeze',{'status':'FR2_REPAIRED_FROZEN_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION','authority':'snapshot_inventory_p4t7_dotnet_repair; native routing/launch/provenance confirmed by coordinator before mutation','source_test':[bind(root/source),bind(root/test)],'shared':unit['shared_after'],'preserved_originals':[bind(p) for p in originals],'checks':[bind(p) for p in receipts],'timings':{json.loads(p.read_text())['stage']:json.loads(p.read_text())['duration_seconds'] for p in receipts},'coverage':bind(coverage),'coverage_original_raw':{'path':'SCRATCH/'+coverage_source.name,'sha256':sha(coverage_source.read_bytes())},'coverage_summary':metrics['summary'],'callable_ranges':ranges,'old_cases_preserved':63,'new_cases':10,'nodes':nodes,'raw_sqlite':{'path':'SCRATCH/'+label+'.coverage','sha256':sha((scratch/(label+'.coverage')).read_bytes())},'limitations':['No MSBuild evaluation or package resolution','Opaque nodes remain counted by parser/index limits','Only .NET pair verified; composed final QA and task acceptance remain coordinator-owned'],'delta':{'ruff':0,'pyright':0,'test_failures':0,'line_percent':0,'branch_percent':0},'repair':'Parent-inherited opaque masks block ProjectExtensions/UsingTask/PropertyGroup descendants before package extraction; genuine Project/Target/Choose/When/Otherwise controls preserved.'})
note=folder/('p4t7-dotnet-repair-handoff.'+stamp+'.md')
note.write_text('# P4-T7 .NET FR2 repair handoff\n\nTimestamp: '+stamp+'\nCommand: poetry run python SCRATCH/p4t7-dotnet-repair-freeze.py '+label+'\nEXIT_CODE: 0\n\nFR2 repaired in the owned pair. Parent-inherited opaque masks prevent data from becoming package declarations. Positive Project, Target, Choose, When and Otherwise controls retain conditions without evaluation.\n\n73 cases pass, including all original63 and10 new cases. Black/Ruff/Pyright pass on stable bytes. Coverage141/141 statements and72/72 branches, all10 callable ranges100%. Files365/465lines. Original failed probe and CR/LF qualifications are referenced unchanged in '+freeze.name+'. New evidence uses explicit LF and JSON-escaped stream presentations; raw streams/SQLite remain separately preserved in SCRATCH. Independent repair confirmation and composed final acceptance remain pending.\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
artifacts=sorted(folder.glob('p4t7-dotnet-repair*'))
for path in artifacts:
    assert b'\r' not in path.read_bytes(),path
staging=save('p4t7-dotnet-repair-staging-manifest',{'files':[bind(root/source),bind(root/test)]+[bind(p) for p in artifacts],'no_git_mutation':True,'original_staging_manifest_references_preserved':True,'status':'REPAIR_SUBSET_ONLY_PENDING_REVIEW'})
print(json.dumps({'freeze':bind(freeze),'staging_manifest':bind(staging),'coverage':metrics['summary'],'source_test':[bind(root/source),bind(root/test)],'shared':unit['shared_after']}))
